title: OptiBook
tagline: An Application Specific High Throughput Blockchain that runs as an OrderBook built on top of OPStack.
description: An Application Specific High Throughput Blockchain that runs as an OrderBook built on top of OPStack. To be more clear we blended the execution engine op-geth to the native order matching engine that first matches order in a deterministic manner once the op-batcher submits the transaction to DA.
how_its_made: It is made using the OPStack, the block explorer used here is blockscout and the chain is deployed on conduit (Roll Up as a service), we made multiple changes to transaction processing and the op-node to make this possible, Blending and playing with the execution engine was the most fun part
